svg.title: qa-platformCore — deterministic engine architecture
svg.text: Consumers — Gherkin text in, verdict and evidence out
the contract every plugin and consumer builds on
Guardrails — why 'Core alone decides pass/fail' survives any AI failure
Generates .feature files from catalog patterns only, calls InProcessTransport
Implements StepReporter as BEStepReporter (evidence, live progress)
Members it may call are pinned by ConsumerSurfaceContractTest
coreVersion must match in both gradle.properties
HttpAgentTransport when layer = MOBILE and the environment has agentUrl
Wire v1: versioned only by the /v1 path, new events additive
Agent URL checked by the outbound policy before the transport is built
Proved by scripts/cli-smoke.sh: catalogs regenerate, ids unique,
a passing feature PASSES and a failing feature FAILS (H2 database)
Core artifacts are not distributed to customers (alcance §1.1)
Changes need approval and keep both consumers working
ApiInternalBoundaryTest fails the build if an outside
consumer imports internal without a whitelist entry
spi: CorePlugin — the one plugin interface
One run — engine.execute(request), nothing shared between runs (G19)
1 new ExecutionContext = ExecutionConfig + ServiceRegistry + VariableStore + EventBus + CancellationSignal, activated on a ThreadLocal
2 onSuiteStart for active plugins in hook order · tag-based activation per run and per scenario
3 Cucumber Runtime.run() with InMemoryResultCollector, ScenarioLifecycleBridge, CucumberStepReporterBridge, RunCancellationHooks
4 CucumberStatusMapping — the single fail-closed mapping → immutable ExecutionResult (status, counts, duration) (G20)
5 finally: onSuiteEnd in reverse order (LIFO) · context.cleanup(): destroy services, clear variables and events, deactivate
aliases keep old derived ids resolving
catalog from what the engine publishes
throws at class init if a declared
i18n display text en, es, fr
Embeds Core as a library and drives InProcessTransport.withDefaults() next to the devices
/v1/capabilities · cancel · Bearer AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN · a client disconnect never kills a run
Devices leased exclusively; port 8090 · container image cannot run iOS (needs macOS)
Step catalog — the published capability statement (P-01)
515 steps in 62 components · patterns frozen against StepIdBaseline (G34) · display text localised, patterns never
14 hidden today: 6 file steps (until the fixture store), 8 conditional 'if present' steps (excluded permanently)
Decided: remove the GraphQL/SOAP advertisement (CAT-07); hidden steps shown with a reason (CAT-02)
BE deploy resolves Core at core.ref

Also: ci.yml on develop, master and release/** · i18n-translate.yml weekly drafts of step descriptions · one Core publish at a time across sessions (.core-publish.lock) · arch tests: ApiInternalBoundaryTest, ServiceFilesValidityTest (G10), NoEmojiGuardTest
Decided: the warm browser pool lives in the customer-side runner, never in Core (NFR-03, G19) · evidence adds SQL, logs and a DOM snapshot on Web failure (EVD-03)
Java 21 · Gradle, 6 modules · Cucumber runtime with protocol plugins · 59,200 lines of main source · no AI, no TMS concepts
Verified against the code on 2026-10-20 · dashed = decided in alcance.md, not built
